abstract: A rarely reported case of cystic teratoma with floating globules or fat balls is presented. Comparative imaging investigations of the floating globules in an ovarian cystic teratoma were performed using magnetic resonance and two- and three-dimensional ultrasound. Ultrasound imaging easily detected the floating globules, especially the 3-dimensional features showed almost the same findings that were observed macroscopically after surgery. Magnetic resonance thus clearly revealed the character of floating globules.
abstract_ja: 稀にしか報告されていない、浮遊性球状物（脂肪球）を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告する。卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の浮遊性球状物について、磁気共鳴画像（MRI）と二次元・三次元超音波検査を用いて比較画像検査を行った。超音波検査では浮遊性球状物を容易に検出でき、特に三次元画像の所見は手術時に肉眼で観察された所見とほぼ同一であった。MRIは浮遊性球状物の性状を明瞭に示した。
